startup_view.label: Open on
startup_view.description: Section selected each time the radio panel opens.

station_limit.label: Stations per view
station_limit.description: Maximum stations shown in Discover, mood, genre, country, and search results.

history_limit.label: Recent history size
history_limit.description: Number of recently played stations retained and shown. Set to zero to clear and disable history.

row_click_action.label: Clicking a station
row_click_action.description: Choose whether clicking a station row plays it immediately or only selects it.

stop_on_panel_close.label: Stop when panel closes
stop_on_panel_close.description: Stop playback when the panel closes, except when it closes to open Radio Tellus settings.

cache_hours.label: Catalog cache lifetime
cache_hours.description: Hours that cached Discover and country lists may be reused when those views are opened.

allow_insecure_http.label: Allow unencrypted HTTP streams
allow_insecure_http.description: Permit playback of unencrypted HTTP audio. Enable only when you trust the station.

isolation_mode.label: Playback isolation
isolation_mode.description: Automatic uses full isolation when available and compatible proxy isolation otherwise. The other modes require their selected behavior.

report_clicks.label: Report station plays
report_clicks.description: Attempt one Radio Browser click report after MPV confirms decoded audio. Opting out suppresses pending and future reports.

previous.label: Select previous station
previous.description: Keyboard shortcut used while the radio panel is focused.

next.label: Select next station
next.description: Keyboard shortcut used while the radio panel is focused.

play.label: Play selected station
play.description: Keyboard shortcut used while the radio panel is focused.

toggle.label: Play or pause
toggle.description: Keyboard shortcut used while the radio panel is focused.

random.label: Random station
random.description: Keyboard shortcut used while the radio panel is focused.

favorite.label: Add or remove favorite
favorite.description: Keyboard shortcut used while the radio panel is focused.

mute.label: Mute or unmute
mute.description: Keyboard shortcut used while the radio panel is focused.

glyph.label: Bar glyph
glyph.description: Glyph shown while stopped, or at all times when Show playback status is disabled.

show_playback_status.label: Show playback status
show_playback_status.description: Override the configured bar glyph while connecting, playing, paused, or playing silently.

show_station_name.label: Show station name
show_station_name.description: Display the station name while playback is connecting, playing, or paused.

station_name_limit.label: Station name length
station_name_limit.description: Maximum Unicode characters displayed for the station name in the bar.

volume_step.label: Bar volume step
volume_step.description: Percentage points changed by each vertical mouse-wheel step over the bar widget.
